facts.text: Cadets pay no tuition, room, or board because the full cost of education is covered by the federal government, and cadets receive a salary while attending.

sources.title: Cost And Tuition - United States Coast Guard Academy
sources.quote: At the Coast Guard Academy there is no cost for tuition, room or board. This elite education, currently valued at more than $280,000, is fully paid for by the government

sources.title: Cost And Tuition - United States Coast Guard Academy
sources.quote: All cadets are paid a salary while attending the Coast Guard Academy.

facts.text: All incoming freshmen begin their military training with Swab Summer, a seven-week program that includes one week aboard the tall ship Eagle.

sources.title: Swab Summer - United States Coast Guard Academy
sources.quote: Swab Summer marks the beginning of freshman year. It is the most difficult and demanding period of military training you will experience as a cadet, taking place over a period of seven weeks, one of which is aboard America's Tall Ship Eagle.
